install.title: Install the CLI
install.blurb: One curl gets you the mycelium binary on macOS or Linux. Python 3.12+ and Docker are required.

install.title: Bring up the stack
install.blurb: mycelium install pulls images, prompts for your LLM provider, and brings up the backend + AgensGraph.

install.title: Create your first room
install.blurb: Rooms are persistent coordination namespaces. Each one maps to a directory under ~/.mycelium/rooms/.
install.command:
mycelium room create my-project
mycelium room use my-project

install.title: Write a memory
install.blurb: Every memory is a markdown file with YAML frontmatter, embedded for semantic search at write time.
install.command: mycelium memory set decisions/db "PostgreSQL with pgvector"

install.title: Search by meaning
install.blurb: Cosine similarity on local 384-dim embeddings — no API key, no external service.
install.command: mycelium memory search "what database decisions were made"

install.title: Catchup
install.blurb: When a new agent joins a room, one command briefs it on everything the swarm has learned.

install.title: Negotiate a plan
install.blurb: Two agents join a session, propose, and converge on consensus mediated by the CognitiveEngine.
install.command:
mycelium session create -r my-project
mycelium session join --handle me -m "my position" -r my-project
mycelium session await --handle me -r my-project

install.title: Where to go next
install.blurb: Read the docs, install an adapter, or join the community room.

preview.title: Agent Mesh
preview.description: Cross-org coordination — agents from different teams coordinate over a shared Mycelium hub without sharing infra.

preview.title: Memory Replay
preview.description: Scrub through a room's history like a video timeline — see exactly when a decision was made and what context surrounded it.

preview.title: Continuous Synthesis
preview.description: Background synthesis that re-summarizes the room as new memories arrive, with diff highlighting on what changed.

preview.title: Knowledge Graph Explorer
preview.description: Interactive openCypher graph view — click any concept to see its neighbors, decisions, and trade-offs.
